flowContents.name: Pipeline Historico USGS
flowContents.comments: Fuente 2 (batch): catálogo histórico USGS por ventanas mensuales, con rate limiting y validación por esquema

processors.name: Limitar ritmo (rate limiting)
processors.comments: Una consulta a la API cada 5 s: evita saturar el servicio público

processors.name: Aplanar FeatureCollection
processors.comments: features[*] -> arreglo de registros planos {evento_id, felt, cdi, mmi, ...}

processors.name: Generar calendario de ventanas
processors.comments: Una línea JSON por ventana mensual. Se dispara al iniciar y luego cada 24 h

processors.name: Descargar GeoJSON (impacto)
processors.comments: Mismas ventanas que el CSV; el GeoJSON incluye felt, cdi, mmi, alert, tsunami, sig

processors.name: Validar registros (esquema Avro)
processors.comments: valid -> zona raw; invalid -> errores (tipos incorrectos o campos obligatorios vacíos)

processors.name: ¿Ventana sin datos?
processors.comments: El USGS responde 204/vacío cuando no hay eventos en la ventana

controllerServices.name: Lector CSV catálogo USGS
controllerServices.comments: Lee el CSV del catálogo con el esquema Avro explícito (tipos y obligatorios)

properties.Schema Text:
{
  "type": "record",
  "name": "SismoHistorico",
  "namespace": "sismos.ingesta",
  "doc": "Columnas del CSV del catalogo USGS (FDSN event query, format=csv). id, time, latitude, longitude y mag son obligatorios.",
  "fields": [
    {"name": "time",            "type": "string"},
    {"name": "latitude",        "type": "double"},
    {"name": "longitude",       "type": "double"},
    {"name": "depth",           "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "mag",             "type": "double"},
    {"name": "magType",         "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "nst",             "type": ["null", "int"],    "default": null},
    {"name": "gap",             "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "dmin",            "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "rms",             "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "net",             "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "id",              "type": "string"},
    {"name": "updated",         "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "place",           "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "type",            "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "horizontalError", "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "depthError",      "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "magError",        "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "magNst",          "type": ["null", "int"],    "default": null},
    {"name": "status",          "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "locationSource",  "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "magSource",       "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null}
  ]
}

controllerServices.name: Lector JSON impacto
controllerServices.comments: Lee el arreglo aplanado por Jolt

properties.Schema Text:
{
  "type": "record",
  "name": "ImpactoSismo",
  "namespace": "sismos.ingesta",
  "doc": "Campos de impacto humano que solo publica el GeoJSON del catalogo USGS (no el CSV). Se unen por evento_id en Spark.",
  "fields": [
    {"name": "evento_id",       "type": "string"},
    {"name": "felt",            "type": ["null", "int"],    "default": null},
    {"name": "cdi",             "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "mmi",             "type": ["null", "double"], "default": null},
    {"name": "alerta_pager",    "type": ["null", "string"], "default": null},
    {"name": "tsunami",         "type": ["null", "int"],    "default": null},
    {"name": "significancia",   "type": ["null", "int"],    "default": null}
  ]
}
